messages:
maria: Quick sanity-check — I ran a tiny bring-up: speculative decoding enabled + GPTQ-int4 on the edge build (nvtx-rt 0.9). Obs: token latency down ~1.8x on median but some tails spiked. attaching quick notes.
ken: Can you paste the config you used? curious about decode params (beam/temperature/early_stop)
tiago: +1 to config. Also need to know batching and kv-cache warmup behavior for the trace.
maria: Config snippet:
```
model: titan-small-70b-quant-gptq
quant: gptq-int4
speculative: enabled
speculative.window: 6
speculative.conf_threshold: 0.82
batch.size: 1
prefetch.kv: true
```
ciara: Nice. What workload? short chat prompts or long context? speculative helps tiny prompts more.
maria: Mostly short prompts (<=64 tokens). Ran a 10k-sample A/B: baseline = same model w/ no speculative, both on same hw.
ken: Results?
maria: Numbers:
- median latency: baseline 92ms -> spec+int4 51ms (1.8x)
- 95p latency: baseline 210ms -> spec+int4 280ms (regression)
- throughput (tokens/s): +72%
- quality (semantic-similarity on heldout suite): drop 0.6% absolute (paired t-test p=0.037)
- safety-regressions: none flagged by auto-filter set
tiago: So overall good median but tail worse. Do we know why 95p spiked? maybe speculative fallback causing duplicated work or longer tail when fallback triggers.
ciara: Could be KV-cache warmup interaction — if speculative path accepts wrong token and we fallback, we replay with full compute and that replay costs on tail.
maria: Logs show about 3.4% of requests hit fallback and those had ~2.6x cost compared to baseline single decode. Fallback rate correlates with prompt length noise.
ops-sandra: Which fallback policy? immediate fallback to exact model or staged re-roll?
maria: Current policy is immediate rerun on mismatch (cheap speculative verifier used). No staged re-roll.
ken: Two quick mitigations to test:
- increase conf_threshold to 0.9 (should reduce fallback, maybe lower median gains)
- staged fallback: run medium-confidence re-roll that uses a smaller beam before full rerun
tiago: Also try keeping speculative but disable KV-prefetch for the first N tokens to avoid cache divergence on fallbacks.
ciara: For eval, we should split by prompt archetype: single-shot vs multi-shot, and by entropy (lexical vs code). Some prompts spike more.
perf-bot: perf-check: run id 2026-03-20-01 completed. Attached summary: median 49-55ms across 3 seeds; fallback rate 3.1-3.6%; 95p variance high when fallback correlated with cold-start.
maria: Plan: (1) run conf_threshold sweep [0.78,0.84,0.9] (2) run with staged fallback (cheap re-roll) (3) diagnostic sweep disabling kv-prefetch on first 16 tokens. I'll push scripts to ci harness.
ken: Also include an A/A with int4+spec vs int8+spec to separate quantization effect from decoding behavior.
ciara: And record per-token entropy trace and fallback triggers, we can correlate whether low-confidence on low-entropy tokens is happening (would be odd).
tiago: One more note: for edge builds, memory fragmentation on device caused occasional extra page faults — correlate with system logs. That can inflate 95p too.
maria: Good catch. I'll capture dmesg and allocator stats during runs.
ops-sandra: If 95p remains worse after mitigations, we should revert speculative for dedicated edge builds until we ship staged fallback.
maria: Agreed. I'll report back with the sweep results (~24h runs). Thanks all :pray:
